name: Cube For A Cure Spring 2016

venue.name: [Oheb Shalom Congregation](https://www.ohebshalom.org/)
venue.details: The competition is in the Mernick and Levi Zucker Halls.

information: Registration is $15 and must be paid online. There is no registration at the door. No food is allowed in the venue, and must be purchased outside the competition. Proceeds from the competition go to Charlie's Angels.
